notes.title: THE BIGGEST (PROBABLY) UPDATE TO ANY GAME EVER (PROBABLY)
notes.content:
[b]Main stuff:[/b]
[list][*]9 (!!!) new maps: 1 for each of forest, winter and city levels and 6 NEW factory maps! Watch out for heavy machinery!!
[*]BOTS! No friends? NO PROBLEM! Let's go babyyy!!! (PS: the bots are really dorky and, be prepared for wierdness level 2000)
[*]Cursor support!! For everything!
[*]Custom games for couch mode! Everything a control freak could ever ask for!
[*]Danger zone for grenades! Don't stand in the red circle! (I think this is a good advice for life in general)
[*]Like 2000 or something bug fixes. Mainly for online but also mainly for everything else. Much better game now![/list]
PPS: Thank you SO hecking much to everyone's that played the game. It's insane that you, a true madlad, would actually play a game I made. Everyone who bought the game is like family. I mean it! Seriously! If you ever need someone to celebrate x-mas with HMU.

[b]thankyouthankyouthankyoutellyourfriendstobuythegamethankyouthankyouthankyou[/b]
